L.Govind Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 12 July, 2024
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.18356 of 2024
Order:

entities.text: L.Govind Kumar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Learned Government Pleader for Endowments appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3 and Sri.J.R.Manaohar Rao, learned standing counsel appearing for respondent Nos.4 and 5.
With their consent, the writ petition is being taken up for disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. This writ petition has been filed seeking the following prayer:-
"to declare the in action of the Respondent No.2- The Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad, Telangana State, in initiating action against the Respondent No.4-Simhavahini Mahankali Temple Trust, Lal Darwaja, Hyderabad, or whoever responsible and liable for the mismanagement and misappropriation of Respondent No.4 temple in spite of the detailed report Rc.No.F/30/2022 dated 01/02/2024 submitted by the Respondent No. 3-The Assistant Commissioner, Endowments Dept,
Hyderabad, specifically pointing out the various acts of mismanagement,
irregularities and illegalities committed by the Self-styled Committee Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple, Laldarwaja, Hyderabad, as illegal, contrary to the provisions of Endowments Act, refusing to exercising the jurisdiction vested with it, and also causing loss to the public/temple funds and consequently direct the Respondent No.2 - The Commissioner Endowments to take action on the report submitted by the Respondent No.3, within time frame and also to further direct the Respondent No.2 the Commissioner, Endowments, Hyderabad, that the ensuing Bonalu festiwal to Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple, Laldarwaja, Hyderabad, scheduled to be conducted on 28/07/2024 and 29/07/2024, under his direct supervision or by appointing a Special Officer for that purpose, and also not to release any funds to the Respondent No.5 pending taking action on the Report submitted by the Respondent No.3 in the interest of Justice."

entities.text: Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad, Telangana State
entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.text: Simhavahini Mahankali Temple Trust, Lal Darwaja, Hyderabad
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 3. The brief facts of the case are that the petitioner is a devotee of Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple, Laldarwaja, Hyderabad, which is famous for its Bonalu and Dasara celebration.

The subject temple was published under Sec.6 C (ii) of the Endowments Act, 1987 (Act No.30/1987) and it is under the administrative control of the Assistant Commissioner, Endowments Department,
Hyderabad.

Further case is that though the subject temple is under control of Endowments Department, the day to day affairs of the subject temple are being managed by the self-styled committee which has no authority under law, and the said self-styled committee is mismanaging and misappropriating the funds of the subject temple.

L.Govind Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171610059/

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner on 17.11.2023, made a representation and requested the respondent No.2 to take action against the persons who illegally are utilizing the temple funds and also against the Endowments Department officials who are supporting the above illegal cause.

Subsequent to the representation dated 17.11.2023, an enquiry was conducted and respondent No.3 vide Rc.No.F/30/2022, dated 01.02.2024, submitted a report to respondent No.2, relevant portion of the same is extracted hereunder:-
"

..............In this regard, it submitted that the Commissioner's and the Deputy Commissioner's references have been forwarded to the Executive Authority of subject temple vide reference 3rd cited and directed to attend this office on 02.08.2023 at 04.00 P.M along with account details from the year-2014 to till date.

In this connection, it is submitted that the meeting was held on 03.08.2023, in the chamber of the Deputy Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad with the Deputy Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad, the Assistant Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad, the Chairman of Self Styled Committee of subject temple and Sri K.Srinivasa Sharma, Incharge Executive Officer of subject temple and discussed regarding the accounts, funds and other issues of subject temple.

Further it is submitted that, the Deputy Commissioner, Endowments Department,
Hyderabad and the Assistant Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad have decided in the above said meeting to issues notices to the former Chairman's and present Chairman of Self Styled Committee of subject temple to submit the accounts of the temple from the year-2014 to 2023.

In this regard, it is submitted that notices have been issued to Sri K.Venkatesh,
Ex-Chairman, Sri C.Shiva Kumar, Ex-Chairman, Sri Ranga Ramesh Goud,
Ex-Chairman and Sri C.Rajender, Present Chairman, Self Styled Committee of subject temple vide reference 4 cited and directed to submit the detailed report regarding accounts of their concerned tenure period from the year-2014 to 2023.
Further, it is submitted that Sri Ranga Rainesh Goud, Ex-Chairman of subject temple has submitted his explanation vide reference 7 cited and stated that he could not submit the accounts, as the accounts were not maintained & audited during his tenure for a period of (12) years and there was no temple bank misappropriation of temple funds in the financial management.
Further, it is submitted that Sri K.Venkatesh, Ex-Chairman and Sri C.Rajender,
Present account during his period.

There might some Chairman, Self Styled Committee of subject temple have submitted their explanations vide reference 8th cited and stated that the financial transaction of the temple are maintained by the Ustava Committee not by the Self-Styled Committee/trust of subject temple.

sentences.text:
In this regard, it is submitted that a notice have been issued to Sri C.Rajender Yadav,
Chairman of subject temple vide reference 9th cited and to submit to the deatails of Ustava Committee who is managing financial transactions of the temple immediately to this office.
But no information have been received to this office till today.

Further, it is submitted that as per. the oral instructions of the Assistant Commissioner, Endowments Department, Hyderabad a letter have been addressed to the Bank Manager, Punjab National Bank, Sultanshahi branch, Hyderabad vide reference 5th cited with a request to furnish the bank account statement of A/c.
No.S.B.0105034285 pertaining to Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple, Laldarwaza,
Hyderabad for the period of January-2021 to August-2023.

In this connection, it is submitted that the Bank Manager, Punjab National Bank,
Sultanshahi branch, Hyderabad have furnished the bank account statement of A/c.No.5.B.0105034285 pertaining to Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple,
Laldarwaza, Hyderabad for the period of January-2021 to August-2023 vide reference 6th cited and on verification of the bank statement; it was found that Sri R.Ravinder have drawn an amount of Rs.6.00 Lakhs on 18.02.2021, Rs.12.00 Lakhs on 18.02.2021 and Rs.1.00 Lakh on 19.06.2021 through vide Cheque no'.s 728530,
728532 & 728535.

In this regard, it is submitted that that Sri K.Venkatesh, Ex-Chairman and Sri C.Rajender Yadav, Chairman of subject temple has stated that they have purchased property (House) bearing No.18-6-717, O/s Laldarwaza, Hyderabad,admeasuring 91 Sqyds/76.08 Sqmts from Sri Sai Ramana Goud, S/o Bikshapathi Goud and registered in the name Sri M.Kartheeka Sharma, Archaka vide sale deed bearing Doct.No.3976/2021, dt:19.06.2021 at the Sub-Registrar, Azampura, Hyderabad through the vendor Sri R.Ravinder, S/o Late R.Laxamaiah, from the temple funds for an amount Rs.19.00 Lakhs vide Cheque No's.728530 @Rs.6.00 Lakhs, 728532 @12.00 Lakhs, dt:18.02.2021 and 728535, dt:19.06.2021 @Rs.1.00 Lakh reference 8th cited.(Copy enclosed).

In this regard, it is submitted that notice have been issued to Sri M.Kartheeka Sharma, Archaka of subject temple vide reference 9th cited and directed to submit to the deatails of property (House) bearing No.18-6-717, O/s Laldarwaza, Hyderabad.
But no information have been received to this office till today.
Further, it is submitted that the Archaka and the other persons who are in management have not submitted any reply to this office till today.

In this regard, it is submitted that as there was no option, other than addressing a letter to the Revenue Divisional Officer, Hyderabad division, who is a special officer for land acquisition appointed by the Collector, Hyderabad for temple expansion.

Accordingly written a letter to the Revenue Divisional Officer, Hyderabad division L.Govind Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171610059/
3 vide this office Rc.No.F/369/2015, dt:16.10.2023, with a request to not to sanction compensation amount to the land purchased in the name of Archaka/Poojari i.e., Sri M.Kartheeka Sharma from Sri Sai Ramana Goud, S/o Sri Bikshapathi, as such the amount is pertaining to subject temple, which was utilised for the purchase of the land/house by Sri M.Kartheeka Sharma, Archaka of subject temple.
In view of the above, I kindly request the Commissioner, Endowments Department,
T.S., Hyderabad to direct, what action has to be taken against the Executive Authorities of Sri Simhavahini Mahankali Temple, Laldarwaza, Hyderabad."
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the above said report was submitted to the respondent No.2 on 01.02.2024 and till today no further action is taken.
Aggrieved by the inaction of respondent authorities in taking steps in respect of the report dated 01.02.2024, this writ petition is filed.

6. Learned Government Pleader for Endowments placed on record the letter bearing No.F/1596/2024 dated 04.07.2024, issued by the respondent No.3 to respondent No.2, wherein the following was stated:-
"In view of the above facts and circumstances, a Special Officer/ Departmental Person Sri M.Srinivasa Sharma/Sri A.Narender/ Sri S.Anjana Reddy, Executive Officer, Gr-I may be appointed to the subject temple during the Celebration of Bonalu Festival- 2024 for a period of One month for peaceful conduct of festival."
7.

Learned Government Pleader further submitted that the Deputy Commissioner, issued proceeding dated 11.07.2024, wherein Ms.S.Anjana Reddy, Executive Officer, Grade-I is instructed to visit the said temple well in advance and co-ordinate with committee members and other departments to complete all the arrangements for successful conclusion of Bonalu Festival in the subject temple in a successful manner.

8. Per contra, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the core issue in the writ petition is with regard to the misappropriation of temple funds and the action to be taken in respect of the report dated 01.02.2024.
It is further submitted that the respondent authorities neither in the letter dated 04.07.2024, nor in the proceeding dated 11.07.2024, had clarified the same.
Hence, pray this Court to direct the respondent authorities to take action in respect of the report dated 01.02.2024 and pass orders in a time bound period.

9. Recording the submission made by learned counsel appearing on either side and in view of the fact that the bonalu festival is forthcoming, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities to streamline and take action in respect to the report dated 01.02.2024 and pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of two (02) months from the date of receipt of copy of this order and communicate the same to the petitioner.

In order to avoid further misappropriation of the subject temple funds, it is made clear that the respondent authorities shall open a new bank account in the name of the subject L.Govind Kumar vs The State Of Telangana on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171610059/
4 temple and shall deposit all the funds that might be collected during the course of the festival.
Needless to say that since the subject temple is published under Section C of the Endowments Act,
1987 (Act No.30/1987), the respondent authorities are directed to see that the affairs of the subject temple comes into their control.

Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
No order as to costs.
